area: UI and accessibility: the native-click acceptance on the Native local installs workflow, and the 2.5 s refresh of the assessment page
title: Flaky native click: the acceptance clicked once on samples that could miss a scroll in flight and failed on any miss; the page smooth-scrolled the Scope page's controls under the pointer and rebuilt unchanged controls and its sign-in live region every 2.5 s

checks.what: last 20 Native local installs runs: 3 passed, 1 in progress; of 16 failed, 13 never started a job (no runner, 0 steps, about 2 s) and 3 failed the browser-verification step on a native click not received (#scenarioRun, the Save as new profile button, #dbScopeRun); locally, on two CPUs, the miss reproduced once in three runs: the click landed on a channel label because the Scope page was still sliding into place

real Chrome: when the pressed button is replaced between press and release, pointerdown, mousedown, pointerup and mouseup arrive but no click, and the page's handler does not run, which is the CI signature (last=false)
two ticks of each 2.5 s timer leave Run assessment, the last-run note's button and the sign-in status untouched (they were rewritten every tick)

a native click that was not received is pressed again (3 attempts at most) only when nothing reached a control; a click that reached the target or another control is never repeated; the final error lists every attempt's reason and events; the 1.5 s receipt window is unchanged
a target is clicked only after the same node keeps the same box (centre and size) over consecutive samples, each taken after two fresh animation frames, is enabled, and elementFromPoint hits it
from the dashboard, the Scope link shows the Scope page at its top at once, and it and Run assessment stay put over the next painted frames (they slid there smoothly, about 150 px)

findings.title: Opening the Scope page (and the Dashboard from the sidebar) scrolled there smoothly after the content was swapped, so Run assessment and the channel ticks slid under a pointer already pressing them; a click meant for Run assessment ticked a channel instead
findings.fix: static/dashboard.js showScopeView and the sidebar's Dashboard link jump ('instant': the page's CSS makes 'auto' smooth)

findings.title: The assessment page's 2.5 s refresh rewrote Run assessment's label and attributes and rebuilt the last-run note (replacing its button) on every tick, unchanged; a press that straddled a tick lost its click
findings.fix: static/dashboard.js refreshCurrent and renderLastRunOrEmpty write only what changed

findings.title: The sign-in status, a polite live region, was rewritten with the same sentence on every 2.5 s render, so some screen readers announced it again and every page observer rescanned

The native-click acceptance dispatched one click and failed on any miss with only 'last=false', so a re-render landing between press and release failed the Native local installs workflow with no diagnosis
findings.fix: tests/js/flow_browser_harness_helpers.mjs classifyMissedClick and clickUntilReceived; tests/js/flow_browser_acceptance.mjs click()
